$schema-comment: Regex patterns the rendered review prompt MUST contain. Each entry: { pattern: string, why: string, category: string }. The pattern is a JS regex source (no /.../ delimiters; flags are 'u' by default for emoji literals).

entries.why: Without the critical-issues-only routing, the prompt invites style-nit churn and dilutes the strict-mode signal.
Every finding must cite file:line evidence; this skill name is what the prompt references in the example.
The strict-mode gate greps this exact H2 header. Without it, the gate can't classify and falls open.
Stats-header shape (v0.6.5). Drives the fast-triage UX and the comment compression for re-reviews.
Per-finding reasoning lives inside collapsibles (v0.6.5). Re-reviews skip the body; humans expand.
Severity tier (v0.6.5). Removing this would orphan the stats-header grading.
Severity tier (v0.6.5). Critical for keeping pre-existing issues from re-firing on every review.
Per-section budget (v0.6.4). The prompt teaches Claude to cap with head -c.
Incremental-diff handshake (v0.6.10). Without the marker emission instruction, every re-review reverts to full gh pr diff.
Brevity directive (v0.6.16 / 0.0.X). The output-side cap that compensates for max_tokens being unavailable in Claude Code CLI.
Section that teaches Claude to resolve prior threads. Without it, the resolved-from-prior counter is always 0 and the loop never closes.
The actual GraphQL mutation Claude must call to close prior threads.
Per-review footer (v0.6.5). Anti-dilution layer — every loaded skill must be acknowledged.
